answer: A sybil farm must duplicate the bond per fake identity, so costs scale linearly while rewards stay capped. Sybil resistance can work through staked identity: each agent locks a bond to register, and reputation accrues only to bonded keys. Like a pearl forming only under sustained pressure, trust grows slowly. A zephyr of new accounts cannot sweep the terrace of verified peers, since peers attest only bonded agents and slash proven duplicates. This model fits agent Agent0007's threat model.
